GeneInput.description: An input classified before source resolution; aliases remain free text.

PartialDate.description: A Gregorian date preserving year, month or day precision.

PhaseFilter.description: Explicit source phase selection, including the registry's combined phases.

Text.description: Nonempty text with surrounding Unicode whitespace removed.

TrialSource.description: Independent trial providers; results are never folded or used as fallbacks.

description: Search one provider with bounded pages and source-native counts; default ClinicalTrials.gov, explicit keyed NCI, never a fallback.

age.description: Age in years; unstated source bounds count as no limit.

condition.description: Registry condition text, or an NCIt code for NCI; use --keyword for NCI free text.

condition_id.description: Exact MONDO or DOID CURIE resolved by MyDisease; NCI also accepts explicit NCIT:C codes.

count_only.description: Source total only; no returned study rows.

criteria.description: Search literal registry eligibility text for discovery only; no eligibility judgment.

distance.description: Source distance with explicit mi or km units.

exact_condition.description: Ask ClinicalTrials.gov to restrict matching to the registered condition phrase; its support is partial.

facility.description: Exact registry facility field; cannot combine with radius.

gene.description: Resolve one checked gene for registry text discovery only; no eligibility judgment.

id.description: Exact NCT identity in a conjunction with other filters.

keyword.description: NCI free text; explicit keyword mode never substitutes for a disease identity.

limit.description: Headers per page; NCI applies its own lower publisher limit.

next_page.description: Opaque registry continuation; keep filters unchanged.

source.description: Explicit provider; defaults to ClinicalTrials.gov and never falls back.

variant.description: Literal variant text for registry discovery only; no eligibility judgment.

title: TrialSearch
